    cr.clientseg,
    ei.debincratio AS dti,
    ca.credutil AS cur,
    -- TDSR = DTI + HousingCosts / MonthlyIncome
    -- Housing costs: if Rent -> estimate from prop financial data, if Own -> mortgage payment, else 0
    CASE

      WHEN e.propfinancialdata->>'propown' = 'Own' AND e.propfinancialdata->'mortgagebits' IS NOT NULL 
           AND (e.propfinancialdata->'mortgagebits')->>'mortbalance' IS NOT NULL 
           AND (e.propfinancialdata->'mortgagebits')->>'mortbalance' != ''
        THEN ((e.propfinancialdata->'mortgagebits')->>'mortbalance')::numeric / 360
      ELSE 0
    END AS housing_cost,
    ei.mthincome,
    ca.totloanamt,
    ca.totcredlimit
  FROM core_record cr
  JOIN employment_and_income ei ON cr.coreregistry = ei.emplcoreref
  JOIN expenses_and_assets e ON ei.emplcoreref = e.expemplref
  JOIN bank_and_transactions b ON e.expemplref = b.bankexpref
  JOIN credit_and_compliance cc ON b.bankexpref = cc.compbankref
  JOIN credit_accounts_and_history ca ON cc.compbankref = ca.histcompref
),

  SELECT

    ROUND(AVG(dti)::numeric, 4) AS avg_dti,
    ROUND(AVG(cur)::numeric, 4) AS avg_cur,
